description: This file defines classes and constants related to Bluetooth GATT (Generic Attribute Profile) socket communication, including Attribute management, GATTSocket class for handling Bluetooth socket operations, and nested classes for command handling and responses.

classes.name: Attribute
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth attribute with type, length, and buffer management, including serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: GATTSocket
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth GATT socket communication, including command execution, notification handling, and security management.

methods.name: Attribute()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing attribute with default values.

methods.name: Attribute(const uint16_t size, const uint8_t stream[])
methods.description: Constructor initializing attribute with provided size and data stream, deserializing the data.

methods.name: ~Attribute()
methods.description: Destructor freeing allocated buffer.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Resets attribute type, offset, and length.

methods.name: IsLoaded() const
methods.description: Checks if the attribute is loaded.

methods.name: Type() const
methods.description: Returns the attribute type.

methods.name: Length() const
methods.description: Returns the length of the attribute data.

methods.name: Load(TYPE& value) const
methods.description: Loads attribute data into the provided variable.

methods.name: Load(bool& value) const
methods.description: Loads boolean value from attribute data.

methods.name: Load(string& value) const
methods.description: Loads string data from attribute.

methods.name: Deserialize(const uint16_t size, const uint8_t stream[])
methods.description: Deserializes data from stream into attribute.

methods.name: GATTSocket(const Core::NodeId& localNode, const Core::NodeId& remoteNode, const uint16_t maxMTU)
methods.description: Constructor initializing GATTSocket with local and remote node IDs and maximum MTU.

methods.name: Security(const uint8_t level)
methods.description: Sets security level for the socket.

methods.name: MTU() const
methods.description: Returns current MTU size.

methods.name: Execute(const uint32_t waitTime, Command& cmd)
methods.description: Executes a command with a wait time, returning status.

methods.name: Execute(const uint32_t waitTime, Command& cmd, const Handler& handler)
methods.description: Executes a command asynchronously with a callback handler.

methods.name: Execute(Command& cmd)
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously.

methods.name: Revoke(const Command& cmd)
methods.description: Revokes a command.

methods.name: Notification(const uint16_t handle, const uint8_t[], const uint16_t)
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle notifications, to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: Operational()
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle operational state, to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: StateChange()
methods.description: Handles state change events.

methods.description: Deserializes incoming data frame.

methods.name: Completed(const Core::IOutbound& data, const uint32_t error_code)
methods.description: Handles completion of outbound data, managing command queue.
